snippet.title: SHUTEN ORDER Launch Trailer (Nintendo Switch, Steam)
snippet.description:
SHUTEN ORDER is available now!
Get the Digital Deluxe Edition! 👉 https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/shuten-order-digital-deluxe-edition-switch/
Get it on Steam! 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3216500/SHUTEN_ORDER/
Get it on the eShop! 👉 https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/shuten-order-switch/

About SHUTEN ORDER
"Happy New End...Have a good end"
"168 remaining until the end of the world..." Humanity is approaching its end.
The murdered leader of a religious nation awakens, incompletely resurrected with amnesia… 
In order to be fully brought back to life, the protagonist must overcome "God's trial": identify and kill their murderer within the time limit. The protagonist, given the alias Rei, dives into the tumultuous city as a detective. The suspects? Five ministers of the Shuten Order. There's no time to investigate them all. Choices must be made, and the pursuit of truth demands sacrifice.

Who killed the Founder? For what reason? Can the mission be fulfilled before time runs out? Thus begins a high-stakes, four-day hunt for the truth.

Five adventure games are combined into one, centered around a suspenseful story full of mystery and intrigue.

▶️ Ministry of Justice: Mystery Adventure
Solve a murder tied to the wealthy Kukuri family and expose the true killer linked to suspect Kishiru Inugami.
▶️ Ministry of Health: Extreme Escape Adventure
Survive a death game alongside suspect Yugen Ushitora where wrong choices can lead directly to life-threatening situations.
▶️ Ministry of Science: Multi-Perspective Novel
Navigate a deadly terrorist attack at a research lab while shifting between characters to avoid fatal outcomes, targeting suspect Teko Ion.
▶️ Ministry of Education: Romance Adventure (?!)
After being poisoned, head to Shuten Academy and unmask three enigmatic girls, one of whom is suspect/poisoner Honoka Kokushikan.
▶️ Ministry of Security: Stealth Action Horror
Flee from the legendary killer Nephilim while investigating suspect Manji Fushicho.
